video_title: Perk to Draymond Green With Steph Out: "You Can't Get 10?"

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins challenges Draymond Green's offensive production without Steph Curry
quotes.excerpt: When Kevin Garnett went out in the season and it was time for Perk to step up, I was getting you double digits.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: When Kevin Garnett went out in the season and it was time for Perk to step up, I was getting you double digits. When it was time for me to step up in the playoffs, I was getting you double digits. I was getting 12 to 15 points a game, sometimes 20. When Kevin Garnett went out, the Celtics defense didn't drop and I was anchoring. When Kevin Garnett went out, my points went up.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on the importance of film study for player development
quotes.excerpt: You're never as bad as you thought and you're never as good as you thought.
quotes.quote: You have to watch a crazy amount of film because that's the only thing that's going to make you even keel. When you don't know, you're emotionally invested in every play. When you watch film, then you realize you're never as bad as you thought and you're never as good as you thought. And then you learn and then you can approach the next day like, okay, here we go.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson explains why team success depends on top-tier talent
quotes.excerpt: If you take Steph Curry, Kristaps Porzingis and Jimmy Butler off your team, your record is going to look like this.
quotes.quote: If you take Steph Curry, Kristaps Porzingis and Jimmy Butler off your team, your record is going to look like this. So, respect to him to continue to perform, but their record is going to look like that. If you take the top three players off of any team, you take LaMelo, Ant and you take Jaden McDaniels off their team, I don't care how good the rookie is, you could have Kentavious Caldwell-Pope, your number is going to be good, you're going to take Ls. You can't feel that pressure of like they still got me, I'm going to win. Not that you're not talented enough, but there is a game management that great players have that put them in a position of, okay, now I got to score, now I got to pace, okay, we're down, okay, the sub. There is a management that goes involved into it.
